statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The patient has symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias
The service is to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
